title: I've build an easy to use dice table to play with friends.
author: Ok-Force-7825
selftext:
So this one is really for the **GMs** and **TTRPG Streamers** out there who do actual plays online (still in beta).

After years of GMing online, I wanted to stop using AvraeBot for dice rolls and recreate the experience of throwing dice on the table. So here it is: [Dice-Caster.com](http://Dice-caster.com)  
It's completely free to use, and I plan to hire artists later to create custom dice skins.

In this video, I explain how to overlay the dice table onto your scene so your audience can see your dice rolls live.

If you create a room, you can invite your players, change the table's look, customize the dice colors, hide your own rolls (GM Screen), clear the table by removing all the dice, make the room private, kick players, and more.

You can connect **up to 12 players** at the same time and see everyone's dice rolls in real time.

And you can choose from **34 different types of dice, ranging from d1 to d120**.

Is this something you'd use in your next session?
